issue: donation_relay_differential.py read the relay IDL and the imported AMM fixture with Path.read_text() and no encoding, so on an ASCII-locale host a non-ASCII documentation byte aborts the fixture build with UnicodeDecodeError before any case runs.
finding: Both JSON inputs carry documentation text. The pump IDL consumers were pinned to UTF-8 earlier for the same reason; these two reads were not covered because they name different literals.

change.unchanged_behaviour: case preparation, instruction construction, the two VM runs, comparison and receipt payload

runs.base: LC_ALL=C LANG=C PYTHONUTF8=0 PYTHONCOERCECLOCALE=0 python -c '<driver>' with a non-ASCII IDL and AMM fixture -> UnicodeDecodeError: 'ascii' codec can't decode byte 0xe2 (both cases)
runs.fixed: same driver -> prepare() returns accounts and the instruction; 2 tests OK

cases: non-ASCII relay IDL decodes and prepares an ordinary donation
non-ASCII AMM fixture decodes and prepares a native donation

limits: This changes only how the two inputs are decoded; it adds no case, no run and no comparison, and changes no capture or prior receipt.
